text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hanging out with Sakura Laurel,
she extended an invitation to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
After this, I'm planning to borrow the kitchen
in the cafeteria to make some espresso.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"So... if it's alright with you,
would you please have some?"
choice_data_list: Are you going to let me drink that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Actually, I've been researching brewing methods lately, and I'd love to hear your thoughts on it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to recreate 'authentic French espresso'
and brew a cup for my father!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I just thought it'd be wonderful to have familiar flavors while you're back in the country!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I'd be happy to help.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-hmm, hmm...♪ Alright, nice! Looks like the tamping turned out great too.
choice_data_list: You're really skilled with your hands!
You're really skilled with your hands!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, Cafe-chan actually taught me,
and I practiced a whole lo~t!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel began to happily talk about when she practiced—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Roasting is a battle against time...
Please quickly remove the coffee beans
from the machine and cool them down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah, got it! Quick and easy, right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ow, ow, hot...!
Roasters get this hot!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay...?
If you got burned, you should put some ice on it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No, I barely grazed it, so I'm fine!
More importantly, we've got to hurry, right?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Next, we grind the beans...
Espresso requires an extra-fine grind. ...However,
the hand grinder I have doesn't produce a uniform size.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please regrind it in the mill several times...
Patience is key... again and again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, looks evenly mixed now, right?
How's this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Almost there.
Please gather beans of similar size...
If we regrind them, I believe the grind will even out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Yeah, got it!
I'll spin it round and round until it gets delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... It's finished, I think?!
This is my espresso...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Well then... itadakimasu!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Huh?! It's super bitter!!
Why...?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I believe it's because... it took time
to cool the beans after taking them out of the roaster.
The roasting continues even during that interval, you see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And also... you turned the mill plenty of times, but... it's not quite there.
...There's a slight inconsistency in the flavor.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Even after taking them out of the machine,
the beans continue to roast... and the bean size
also changes the flavor profile, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Which means you can fine-tune the taste just by changing the roast and grind size!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
All right, one step forward!
I'll aim for the flavor Dad loves,
and try as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Crafting the ideal espresso...
I will help you... all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"The brew time was spot on... and yep!
A gorgeous caramel color! The crema is perfect too♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel handles the coffee with meticulous care right to the very end. It was clear she had mastered the skill after challenging herself through countless failures.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, the finest espresso!
Please enjoy, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: How does it taste...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yay, 100 points! Woo-hoo~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well now, I'm gonna give it a try too!
Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Yeah! It's delicious!
But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Dad likes a pleasant acidity, so maybe a slightly milder flavor would be better.
—Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you taste test
again for me next time too?
choice_data_list: The coffee tastes delicious as it is, too—I really like it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
I'll leap right over your expectations, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah, maybe next time I'll try making some treats that go well with espresso too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Please give that one a taste too, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So this is what you like, Trainer...
Hm, hm. I'll make sure to remember that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm so glad
you drank it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say it's delicious
gives me so much confidence♪
